title: A watcher that refuses a red merge, into any branch, without waiting for anyone to look
goal: Two scripts, needing only node and gh. One reports the check state of every open pull request and exits non-zero when any is red, so it runs one-shot or inside a polling monitor. The other guards one pull request before merge and refuses unless every check passed, whatever its base branch, so a stacked merge is held to the same bar as main. Branch protection guards only main, and it is off; this depends on neither it nor anyone noticing.
acceptance: Given an open pull request with a failing check, when scripts/ci-watch.mjs runs, then it names the pull request, the failing check and its run link, and exits non-zero
Given every open pull request is green, when scripts/ci-watch.mjs runs, then it exits zero
Given a pull request with a pending, failing, cancelled or skipped check, when scripts/pre-merge-check.mjs is run for it, then it refuses and names what is not green
Given a pull request whose base is not main and whose checks all pass, when scripts/pre-merge-check.mjs runs for it, then it allows the merge and states the base branch
Given a check reported as skipped, when either script runs, then it is treated as not passed rather than as a pass
next: Write scripts/ci-watch.mjs and scripts/pre-merge-check.mjs with tests, then arm a Monitor poll loop over open pull requests
